subject.title: fix(security): close forged-marker sanitization bypass and harden web_search boundary

question: Should this protected security hardening merge with fail-closed handling for every non-JSON `web_search` provider result, or should supported provider contracts preserve a narrower compatibility path?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the result for non-JSON plugin/provider payloads; source inspection supports the hardening goal but cannot choose the long-term supported provider boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Confirm JSON-only provider contract
options.body: Merge after rebasing and completing checks, treating non-JSON provider outputs as invalid and returning the new safe `provider_error`.

options.title: Preserve a documented compatible shape
options.body: Revise the snapshot boundary only if maintainers identify a supported provider return shape that is non-JSON and must remain accepted.

recommendation.title: Confirm JSON-only provider contract
recommendation.body: Merge after rebasing and completing checks, treating non-JSON provider outputs as invalid and returning the new safe `provider_error`.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work connects them directly to the Code Mode and web-search output-contract surface.
